description: CR 611.3a / 612.1 a static text change behind an 'as long as' clause rewrites Kird Ape only while that clause holds
note: alice controls Synthetic Conditional Rewording (Forest -> Island in creatures' text as long as she controls an Island); bob controls Kird Ape and a Forest. With no Island the change is off and the Ape, asking after a Forest, is 2/3: an engine ignoring the clause reads 1/1. alice plays an Island, the change turns on, and the Ape asks bob for an Island he lacks: 1/1, where an engine dropping the change reads 2/3.
